d: Bihar ke saharsa jile sthit mandal kara (jel) ke bhitar bhi lok aastha ke char divsiy mahaparv chhath puja ki dhum dekhne ko mil rahi hai. jel ki chardivari ke andar bandiyon ke bich chhath parv ko lekar jabardast utsah aur bhakti ka mahaul bana huaa hai. mandal kara ke bhitar pure niyam-nishtha aur pavitrata ke sath chhath mahaparv manaya ja raha hai.
